release_wide_changes.compatibility: Removed compiler SP/AsyncTP PassConfig fields reject stale values; cascade flag is a warning/no-op. Model-level HC/MoE SP is separate.
release_wide_changes.agent_protocol: Startup parser/tokenizer validation; hf requires compatible response_template; Responses single-call filtering and required-tool streaming changes. Existing Chat filtering predates v0.32.
release_wide_changes.shared_memory: Contrary to release notes, enable_shm_tensor_arena is false/experimental opt-in in pinned source; eligible all-local queues reserve about 2 GiB plus metadata each, pages populated lazily.
release_wide_changes.host_paths: Local non-weight tokenizer snapshots and best-effort open-connection balancing with multiple Python API workers; not KServe replica/GPU-load balancing.

adversarial_recheck.scope: Selected model/kernel, Qwen preprocessing/cache precision, release-wide API and configuration omissions; two independent reviewers plus integration review. No exhaustive whole-tree or runtime qualification.
